title: Concept: Conda channel TLS verification disabled
description: .condarc declares an `ssl_verify` switch set to false, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads an `ssl_verify` switch set to false.
